# Jersey Trust

> UAE-based Corporate Services Provider specialising in RAK ICC Foundations, company formation, and corporate structuring for HNWIs, entrepreneurs, and family offices worldwide.

Jersey Trust helps international clients set up RAK ICC Foundations, UAE Mainland and Free Zone companies, and Golden Visa residency. Full-service: formation, banking introductions, ongoing corporate maintenance.

## Services

- [Foundations](https://jerseytrust.ae/foundations): RAK ICC Foundation setup, structuring, and administration
- [Golden Visa](https://jerseytrust.ae/golden-visa): 10-year UAE residency by investment / talent route
- [Services](https://jerseytrust.ae/services): Company formation, nominee services, corporate secretarial, PRO services

## Company

- [About](https://jerseytrust.ae/about): Team, licensing, track record
- [FAQ](https://jerseytrust.ae/faq): Jurisdictional questions, timelines, costs
- [Contact](https://jerseytrust.ae/contact): Onboarding enquiries

## Key facts

- **Primary jurisdiction**: RAK ICC (Ras Al Khaimah International Corporate Centre), UAE
- **Flagship product**: RAK ICC Foundations, ideal for HNWIs needing asset-holding, succession planning, and privacy
- **Target clients**: Global HNWIs, entrepreneurs, family offices, crypto-native founders
- **Languages**: English (primary), Arabic, French
- **CEO**: Will Wilde (ww@jerseytrust.ae)
